before.cause: Native RGB export rejects the authored CAS request while the same files decode and geometry/color export controls pass.

qualification: Native contrast-adaptive sharpening now runs after geometry and negate, before color curves.
Separate opacity uses the CAS alpha bit8; RGB G/B/R bits1/2/4 preserve channel ordering. No public interface changed.
Twenty short authored clips include added smooth gradients. Zero-plane identity and nontrivial RGB/opacity changes are asserted; all mask and coded-depth variants match qualified packed RGBA kernels.
YUV444A alpha-only sharpening preserves color. Native software playback verifies exact filtered pixels, clocks, seek, rewind and EOF.
Invalid settings, packet count, packet bytes and controlled-memory limits fail without publishing output. Ordinary tests use saved fixtures without FFmpeg or network.
counting: One spatial sharpening integration capability, including its separate-opacity channel semantics; fixture/mask/depth variants do not add IDs.
